sum: Castor Maritime Inc. operates as a shipping and energy company worldwide. The company operates through Dry Bulk, Containership, and Asset Management segments. It offers seaborne transportation services for dry bulk and containership cargoes; and transportation of commodities, such as iron ore, coal, and soybeans. The company also provides technical and commercial ship management and energy infrastructure project services. As of December 31, 2025, the company owned and operated a fleet of 9 vessels primarily consisting of four Kamsarmax, three Panamax, and one Ultramax dry bulk vessels, as well as one 1,850 TEU containerships. Castor Maritime Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Limassol, Cyprus.
